text:
zara: Planning a compact base-image rebuild next Thu (2026-05-21). Need quick preflight: RBAC window, audit sinks, vuln gating, and rollback checklist.
ezra: Proposed flow: 90m signer window. Prefer SA impersonation but can do add/remove binding if needed.
mike: If binding route, I'll run: 
``
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/signer --member="serviceAccount:svc-image-builder@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.signer"
```
and remove after.
zara: Audit checklist: 1) IAM policy change logged to `projects/redwood-logs/sinks/kms-iam`; 2) KMS CryptoKey access logs -> SIEM `kms-usage`; 3) cosign sigs/attestations recorded in Artifact Registry metadata.
ezra: Vulnerability gating: capture pre-scrub trivy + syft SBOM. Post-scrub run `trivy fs --severity CRITICAL,HIGH` and fail if new CRITICALs appear. We'll attach diffs to the release.
mike: Runtime canary: deploy 2 pods, 3m warmup, hit `/healthz` + small predict; rollback if error rate >7% or p95 >300ms. Add runbook snippet to revoke binding/impersonation on rollback.
zara: I'll create a short PR template requiring 1 ENG + 1 SEC approval and include pre/post SBOM + vuln outputs. sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: `2026-05-21T08:30:00Z` -> 30m pre-window post to #eng-security.
mike: I'll add add/remove scripts under `infra/signer-window/` and push revoke script.
ezra: I'll implement the diff check in the pipeline and fail CI on regressions.
zara: Please ack when PRs are live. :thumbsup:
mike: ack.
ezra: ack.
sec-bot: Alert `kms-binding-change` will open incident in #eng-oncall if fired outside window.
